answer: Build standing as a trellis: every attestation must rest on two independent supports, and those supports must come from different lagoons, isolated pools that never exchange members, so one cluster cannot supply both. The trellis is then laid flat on a public mesa where each support is listed in the open, so double-pledging becomes visible at a glance: if one head's tokens prop up two claims, the shared base shows immediately. A fleet would need two disjoint pools per clone, and the second pool can already read the first pool's ledger before pledging.
